clue.text: Battle in street leading to goods impounded by law

indicators.note: one piece leading to another comes before it in the answer
something impounded is shut up inside, so the goods sit within the law

parts.note: a law is a rule
G is short for good, so GG stands for goods

explanation.surface: A legal fight over property seized under a statute, starting out on the street.
explanation.definitionFit: A battle is a fight or hard contest, the same as a struggle.

clue.text: One on board giving measure of programme's success

definitions.meaning: a sailor of non-officer rank serving on a ship
viewing figures used to judge a television show

explanation.surface: A sailor's share of the audience figures for a television show.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a naval sailor and an audience figure for a broadcast.

clue.text: Hotel in reach in poor quarter

indicators.note: the letter goes in the phrase for reach

parts.note: to reach a place is to get to it
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A hotel within easy distance of a deprived district of town.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghetto is a deprived, overcrowded district of a city, a poor area of town.

clue.text: A trite rule that's spoiled written material

indicators.note: something spoiled is ruined, so these letters lose their order

explanation.surface: A tired cliché of a rule that has ruined someone's writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Literature means books and writings in general, printed texts on a subject.

clue.text: Clever group of diners disregarding time

indicators.note: disregarding the time means leaving its letter out of the group

parts.note: diners sitting together form a table

explanation.surface: A smart party of restaurant guests who pay no attention to the clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Clever and able are synonyms for someone skilled or competent.

clue.text: Sack male in top disciplinary facility

parts.note: to sack someone is to give them the boot

indicators.note: the letter for male goes in the word for top

parts.note: a cap is a top or lid

explanation.surface: Firing the man at the head of a correctional unit.
explanation.definitionFit: A boot camp is a harsh training camp for recruits or young offenders, run with strict discipline.

clue.text: Greeting penned by a poet I fancy in African country

indicators.note: something penned is enclosed, so the greeting sits within the other letters
fancy as an adjective means elaborate or reworked, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: hi is a casual greeting

explanation.surface: A welcome written by a whimsical poet, who imagines herself in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethiopia is a nation in the Horn of Africa, with Addis Ababa as its capital.

clue.text: Device that could make mum more embarrassed

parts.note: mum means silent, and sh is the call for silence
someone embarrassed goes red, so more embarrassed is redder

explanation.surface: A gadget that would make one's mother blush even more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' looks like a mother but means quiet, as in 'keep mum'.
explanation.definitionFit: A shredder is a machine that cuts paper into strips, an office gadget.

clue.text: Musical success by star covering tango up to now

parts.note: a successful song or record is a hit

indicators.note: the star covering the tango means it wraps round that letter

parts.note: the star of a story is its hero
T is tango in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A smash show whose lead performer dances the tango, enjoying success to date.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto is a formal adverb meaning until this point in time.

clue.text: Mess when accommodated in two hospitals

indicators.note: something accommodated in a place is housed inside it

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital, so two give HH
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'

explanation.surface: A shambles when a patient is put up in two hospitals at once.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a hash of something is to make a mess of it; a hash is a jumble.

clue.text: Trouble in Belgium with alternative on the right

indicators.note: in an across answer the piece on the right comes after the first

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium
an alternative is another or other choice

explanation.surface: Difficulties in Belgium involving another option favoured by the political right.
explanation.definitionFit: To trouble someone is to bother them; as nouns both mean inconvenience or fuss.

clue.text: Model train in state that's healthy

indicators.note: the reworked letters go in the middle of the word for state

parts.note: to state something is to say it

indicators.note: to model is to shape or form, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A toy train kept in good working order and clean condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanitary means hygienic, conducive to good health.

clue.text: Agreement in a combination of notes, we hear

indicators.note: says the phrase is heard rather than written, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: several notes played together make a chord

explanation.surface: Musicians reaching harmony through a pleasing combination of notes.
explanation.definitionFit: An accord is a formal agreement or state of harmony between parties.

clue.text: Serve e.g. grub cooked using no animals ultimately — as this?

definitions.text: Serve e.g. grub cooked using no animals ultimately — as this?

indicators.note: cooked food is altered, so these letters are reworked
says a letter must be removed from the cooked letters
ultimately points to the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: Advice to dish up a meal made without any animal products, as this patty is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges SERVE EG GRUB less the S that ends 'animals'.
explanation.definitionFit: A meat-free patty is food prepared with no animals, made from vegetables or pulses.

clue.text: Make more efficient floundering men's retail

indicators.note: floundering means struggling clumsily, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A business plan to rescue a struggling menswear shop by trimming waste.
explanation.definitionFit: To streamline an organisation is to simplify it so it works faster and wastes less.

clue.text: Very critical about supporting son, and object

indicators.note: in a down answer a supporting piece sits beneath the other

parts.note: ca. is short for circa, Latin for about, used with dates
an object is a thing

explanation.surface: A harsh review concerning a boy getting backing, plus a protest.
explanation.definitionFit: Scathing criticism is severe and withering, harshly disapproving in tone.

clue.text: Rejoicing in lab crazily interrupts project

indicators.note: the reworked letters break into the middle of the word for project

parts.note: to project is to stick out or jut

indicators.note: crazily means wildly, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Wild celebration in a laboratory that halts work on a scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: Jubilant means triumphantly happy, rejoicing at success.

clue.text: Rigid objections raised and tolerated endlessly

indicators.note: raised in a down answer means the word is read upwards

parts.note: ifs and buts are objections

indicators.note: with its end gone, the word loses its last letter

parts.note: something tolerated is borne

explanation.surface: Firm protests voiced and put up with without limit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns BUTS upwards to STUB; 'endlessly' trims BORNE to BORN.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone obstinate is rigid, unwilling to change their position.

clue.text: Solicit group of brothers for judicial direction?

parts.note: to court favour or votes is to solicit them
monks or friars form a religious order

explanation.surface: Seeking help from a fraternity in order to obtain a ruling from a judge.
explanation.definitionFit: An instruction issued by a judge is a legal command from the bench.

clue.text: Be economical, having munched crisp over minute

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are spread over the letter for minute, enclosing it
something munched is chewed up, so these letters are mangled

explanation.surface: Saving money by eating a single crisp for a whole minute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'munched' turns CRISP into SCRIP, which goes round M.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrimp is to be thrifty, spending as little as possible.

clue.text: Decadent English fellows having summer in Paris

parts.note: F is short for fellow, so FF is fellows
été is French for summer

explanation.surface: Indulgent Englishmen spending the summer season in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: Effete means weak and over-refined, the self-indulgence of a declining class.

clue.text: A big strike upset international alliance

indicators.note: upset in a down answer means turned upside down, read upwards

parts.note: a six is the biggest single hit in cricket

explanation.surface: A huge industrial walkout that disrupted an agreement between nations.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a six is a hit clearing the boundary without bouncing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Axis was the wartime pact of Germany, Italy and Japan, a coalition of nations.

clue.text: Hear about the Italian bishop's hat

indicators.note: the word for hear goes about the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: a judge hears or tries a case
il is Italian for the
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: An instruction to listen to stories of an Italian bishop's headwear.
explanation.definitionFit: A trilby is a soft felt hat with a dented crown, a kind of headgear.

clue.text: Expedient required for fleet facing difficulty

indicators.note: one piece facing another stands in front of it

parts.note: fleet of foot means fast or quick
being in a fix is being in a difficulty

explanation.surface: A naval fleet in trouble needs some practical measure to get by.
explanation.definitionFit: An expedient is a makeshift measure, a fast temporary remedy for a problem.

clue.text: Where eight might be found as an unbroken sequence

definitions.meaning: a rowing eight sits ... boat, the setter's playful sense
things happening consecutively happen one after another without a break

explanation.definitionFit: Successive wins come consecutively, and an eight rows a boat on the river.

clue.text: In America, single, drunk, showing brutish quality

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go in the abbreviation for America

parts.note: US is short for the United States of America

indicators.note: drunk means not steady, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An unattached American, intoxicated and behaving like a brute.
explanation.definitionFit: Brutishness shows coarse, repulsive conduct, one sense of the noun for being hideous.

clue.text: Attack vehicle in reservoir

definitions.meaning: an armoured military vehicle with a gun turret
a container or pool for storing water or fuel

explanation.surface: An assault vehicle positioned inside a lake used for water supply.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an armoured fighting vehicle and a large storage container for liquid.

clue.text: Support the man clearly discontented in view of the future?

parts.note: a prop is a support
he is the pronoun for a man

indicators.note: with its contents gone, only the outer letters of the word remain

explanation.surface: Backing a man who is visibly unhappy with the outlook ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: A prediction is a statement of what is foreseen, a forecast of coming events.
